Subject: Severe latencies / 5xx spike impacting production — immediate help needed

Hi Avery / Marissa,

We're seeing sustained latency increases and a 5xx error wave in our production inference path since ~08:50 PDT. P95 latency has jumped from 220ms to ~1.8s for our highest-volume route and error rate is ~3.4% (was <0.2%). This is tied to the dedicated GPU pool reserved for our account — we are below our committed throughput (we bought reserved capacity for this predictable load).

Impact: customer-facing search and chat experiences are timing out for a subset of sessions; retention-sensitive flows are failing. We need: 1) immediate mitigation to stop the 5xx wave, 2) clarity on whether reserved throughput is being honored, and 3) an ETA for a durable fix.

I've attached a log bundle and a kv-cache dump. Rajiv and I are available on a call now or in the next 30 minutes. This is causing live revenue impact. Please escalate to engineering and leadership.

Attachments: support_log_20260721.tar.gz (log bundle), kv_cache_dump_20260721.json

Quick triage notes from infra:
- Observed behavior: KV-cache eviction rate on the dedicated pool spiked at 08:47 PDT. Evictions caused increased prefix recompute and bursty kernel loads. At the same time, an adjacent tenant pushed a sudden burst of long-sequence requests which saturated our intra-node GPU queues.
- Effect: token queueing and backpressure cascaded to the request routers, manifesting as higher p95 and intermittent 5xx (OOM/retry-induced errors).

Immediate mitigations applied (10:00 PDT):
1) Isolated noisy neighbor via temporary slot rebalancing (moved their fleet to spare nodes).
2) Enabled isolated reservation lane for FinEdge to honor committed throughput (activating reserved lane increases guaranteed QPS).
3) Rolled a low-risk model variant (int8 quantized) for non-critical routes to reduce kernel load — applied to 10% traffic as canary.

Metric snapshot attached: metrics_snapshot_20260721.png

Next steps:
- Monitor for 30m, if p95 returns under 400ms and error rate <0.5% we keep the temporary mitigations and plan a more durable slot-sizing change.
- If issue persists, we will request a short-term capacity bump and coordinate procurement for an expanded dedicated pool.

ETA for stable rollback of mitigations (if good): 10:45 PDT.

-David
David Kim
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
